world_map.lore: Haven, capital of Hamen, on the River Flame floodplain just above the delta: Erros the Founder's outer wall round canal-fed fields, the inner defences, and three colossal white-marble stepped pyramid-palaces from which House Amaranth rules. "Capital of Hamen on the River Flame floodplain: Erros the Founder's outer wall, inner defences and the stepped pyramid-palaces." (atlas_data.json) Queen Meret Amaranth reigns; House Nereth keeps the canals and sluices. Roughly 400,000-600,000 people (the brief).
